svg.title: How a change of a template reaches the repositories
svg.desc: A pull request in this repository changes templates/. Its checks lint the templates and check the set-up with them installed, while the required check issue-assistant compares this repository's own workflows with the release that they pin, so it stays green. Merged, the change becomes a release. A pull request in the repository blueprint installs that release there and moves the pins of the action. The next release of the blueprint brings it to every repository made from it, this one too. Repositories without the blueprint get the release from Dependabot and run install again.
